dataLifecycle.onTermination: destroy all volumes and the vault; nothing is exported

description: The canonical V1.13 base cell. Five bricks, no catalogue brick, no domain, no account. Every other universe starts from this shape.

brick-vault.role: Holds the secrets this universe — and only this universe — may read

specialize.how: Generate a master key locally, then bootstrap from resources

cognition.rationale: Deterministic secret storage and decryption. No model, ever.

brick-logger.role: Keeps the append-only evidence that each step actually happened

cognition.rationale: Append-only structured audit. No model, ever.

brick-queue.role: Persistent work ledger, so nothing is lost between a decision and its execution

cognition.rationale: Dispatch is mechanical. Each job carries its own cognitive requirement, not the queue.

brick-maestro.role: Paces the declared task-* entries and hands each beat to the queue

specialize.how: MAESTRO_TASKS_FILE points at this universe's task-schedule.json

cognition.rationale: Scheduler and auditor. Rule 21: never executes heavy transformation itself. It vendors @shaper/pkg-agent-runtime, which dispatches a task to the selected bridge.

brick-bridge-opencode.role: The one AI engine this universe is allowed to spend work on

specialize.how: No model is baked in: it is measured from the target host at deployment (Rule 7)

cognition.rationale: Provides cognition to the universe. Declares the floor it can supply with free models; measure from the target host before selecting one.
